messages:
Nadia: Quick sync: we need to finalize the accounting boundary for multi-model requests (few-shot + tool calls). Are tokens charged to the calling model or split across models invoked?

Ethan: Billing model we agreed earlier was "primary model pays for generation tokens, tool calls attribute to the tool model" but it's fuzzy for chained calls. Need clear rule for ledger.

Priyanka: Proposal: attribute tokens to the call site that triggered the forward pass. Example: user->chat-model which calls a reranker -> reranker tokens are billed to reranker owner. Ledger should store attribution chain.

Samir: Storing chain increases record size. Alternative: compute aggregation at canonicalization and store flattened attribution buckets. For audits we can optionally rehydrate chain from raw.

Nadia: Flattened buckets are fine. Also include an "attribution_trace_id" which references rehydratable chain in raw. That way finance can ask for full trace if needed.

Ethan: Agree. Also need to handle tool retries: same dedupe/fingerprint mechanism but with call-site included in fingerprint composition.

Priyanka: Schema sample for canonical record: {tenant, fingerprint, flattened_attribution:[{owner, tokens}], tokens_total, attribution_rules_version, attribution_trace_id, schema_id}. We'll version it v1-alpha.

Samir: Perf: flattened buckets reduce read-time CPU for billing and are friendly for rollups. Good tradeoff.

LogBot: Snapshot: attribution-boundary-sync at 2026-03-20T14:00Z saved.

Nadia: Migration: dual-write flattened buckets alongside legacy raw-chain for 2w, then flip. Need to ensure rollup jobs accept flattened shape.

Ethan: Also add unit tests for reranker/tool attribution in the billing harness.

Priyanka: I'll add to the RFC. Samir: can you add a field size budget so we don't bloat ledger records? Maybe cap flattened buckets to top-10 owners and overflow into trace.

Samir: Yep cap + overflow pointer.

Nadia: Great. I'll draft a short follow-up doc and update the RFC with examples.
